items.title: Pete Levin interviewed by Monk Rowe, Danbury, Connecticut, November 20, 2001
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe and we are in Danbury, Connecticut. I’m very pleased to have Pete Levin with me today for the Jazz Archive.

ctx.x: Pete was interviewed in Danbury, Connecticut on November 20, 2001, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe and we are in Danbury, Connecticut. I’m very pleased to have Pete Levin with me today for the Jazz Archive. And I was looking at your resume and so forth, and I’m wondering, if you have a business card, what does it say on it?
